stories.title: CSDA Vendor – Pixxel
stories.summary: Pixxel operates a constellation of high-resolution hyperspectral Earth observation satellites designed to deliver precise spectral measurements of Earth’s surface for frequent global monitoring. Its operational Firefly constellation provides analysis-ready data across more than 135 spectral bands in the visible and near-infrared (VNIR) range at a 5-meter ground sample distance.
